lifecycleEvidence.excerpt:
IMPERMAX IS SHUTTING DOWN
After 5 years of activity, our journey has sadly come to an end. We kindly ask you to withdraw your remaining funds deposited on our app.
While Impermax smart contracts will keep working, our impermax.finance UI will shut down within the next few months.
Thanks for all the support, The Impermax Team
